summary: Add a --dry-run flag to the sync command
problem: Sync changes files immediately, so users cannot review what it will do.
motivation: New machines are set up rarely and mistakes are costly.
goal: Preview every change sync would make without touching the filesystem.
proposed_change: Add `--dry-run` to `dotlab sync` that prints the planned link/copy/remove actions and exits 0.
acceptance: Exit code is 0 when the plan is valid
